waterfall_K.duty: A (study B): 0.2 mm rms per axis at 8 Hz, 70 % contact, writing 30.5 mm/s, mean 35-75 deg

steps.name: K as published
steps.what: study K's chain at duty A: study B's P_cont 7.56 mW (results/revK/revK.json power_table km1_q0.2) x 1.80 x 1.21 + the 2.6 mN guide friction, K_m at the upper bound (study K's low end)
steps.label: CALCULATION

steps.name: coherent harmonic load
steps.what: the same chain re-run with bnib/loads.py as the pass corrected it (spring and inertia keep their phase)
steps.label: CALCULATION

steps.name: study B's loads, per axis
steps.what: study B's loads (bnib/loads.loads_at with the counter-face: F_s along the pen, +1 sigma IMU errors, the weight trimmed in contact) re-implemented per axis with study K's K_m (0.334 / 0.272) in place of the scalar x 1.80, roll 0, linear wires, 2.6 mN guide, 20 degC
steps.label: CALCULATION

steps.name: all rolls
steps.what: mean over twelve rolls (study B's fast mode evaluates roll 0 only; with unequal x and y K_m the roll matters)
steps.label: CALCULATION

steps.name: study K's residual
steps.what: study K's face-parallelism Monte Carlo (5.7 mN mean, 6.4 mN rms) in place of study B's deterministic +1 sigma IMU residual (16 mN at 35 deg); weight still trimmed, F_s still along the pen
steps.label: CALCULATION

steps.name: ink force N = F_n
steps.what: study K's constant-force float: the ball's normal force is F_n = 0.196 N at every tilt (study B's duty model used F_s / sin(theta): 0.26 N at 35 deg), so the ball's drag is 28 mN instead of 38 mN at 35 deg
steps.label: CALCULATION

steps.name: gravity held in contact
steps.what: study K's head keeps the face parallel to the paper, so the coils hold the 3.44 g moving mass (28 mN at 35 deg) in contact as well as pen-up; study B's schedule trimmed the face to cancel it in contact and study K's budget inherited that
steps.label: CALCULATION

steps.name: guide preload drag
steps.what: the ball guide's drag from its 4 N internal preload per race (8.1 mN) instead of the couple's ball load alone (2.6 mN) (the pass's correction)
steps.label: CALCULATION

steps.name: nonlinear wires
steps.what: the pass's beam-column wires with study K's 10,000 N/m anchor (at duty A's 0.28 mm radius the force is small)
steps.label: CALCULATION

steps.name: map centre
steps.what: study K's coil's centre force matrix from this package's map (fine quadrature, raw image method: 0.329 / 0.266 N/sqrt(W)) in place of study K's values scaled to study B's calibration (0.334 / 0.272)
steps.label: CALCULATION

steps.name: coil and magnet temperature
steps.what: copper resistance and Br at the coil temperature of study K's fin model (33.0 degC at 35 deg; study K computed at 20 degC)
steps.label: CALCULATION

steps.name: K_m x 0.7 at the centre
steps.what: study K's high-end convention (centre K_m x 0.7)
steps.label: CALCULATION

steps.name: weakest point x 0.7
steps.what: the brief's convention: the smallest singular value of the force matrix over the usable disk x 0.7 in every direction
steps.label: CALCULATION

rows.topology: wires alone (study B / K's four 0.10 mm C17200 wires on a 5.5 mm circle)
rows.reason: 0.70 N of compression per wire against 34.4 mN fixed-fixed buckling (study K N14)

rows.topology: four wires pre-tensioned to 1.19 N each (circle 5.5 mm, 34.0 mm long)
rows.reason: tension stiffening n T / L: the spring force at the stop exceeds the moving mass's weight

rows.topology: four wires pre-tensioned to 0.72 N each (circle 9.0 mm, 40.0 mm long)
rows.reason: tension stiffening n T / L: the spring force at the stop exceeds the moving mass's weight

rows.topology: necked struts (stiff middle, short C17200 hinges) in place of wires and balls
rows.reason: a hinge short enough to carry the couple's compression twice over bends to Goodman 1.04 at the stop (target 1.5)

rows.topology: two planar flexure stages (beams 15 x taller than wide, 5 N/m lateral each, 20 mm apart)
rows.reason: tilt 149 mrad under the couple (5.4 mm at the ball): the out-of-plane to in-plane stiffness ratio of a planar beam is only (height / width)^2

rows.topology: nested parallel-blade XY stage (two blades per axis, 16 mm apart)
